title: Software Engineer, iOS Core Product - Hamburg, Germany
description:
The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its App of the Day.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

With the growth of our iOS app, being the #18 productivity app in the App Store category and also our recent recognition as Apple's 2025 Design Award for inclusivity, we find the need for a Senior iOS Engineer to help us support the new user base as well as work on new and exciting projects to push our missing forward.   

This is a key role and ideal for someone who thinks strategically, enjoys fast-paced environments, passionate about making product decisions, and has experience building great user experiences that delight users.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount. 

Our interview process involves several technical interviews and we aim to complete them within 1 week. 

What You'll Do

  • Opportunity to lead key engineering and product decisions
  • Actively shipping production code for the Speechify iOS app
  • Work within a dedicated product team
  • Participate in product discussions to shape the product roadmap
  • Maintain and enhance the existing complex app architecture

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • Experience. You've worked on products that scaled to a large user base
  • Track record. You have worked on various products from inception to decent traction. You have been responsible for engineering the product
  • Customer obsession. We expect every team member whose responsibilities directly impact customers to be constantly obsessed about providing the best possible experience
  • Product thinking. You make thoughtful decisions about the evolution of your product and support internal teams and designers into taking the right direction
  • Speed. You work quickly to generate ideas and know how to decide which things can ship now and what things need time
  • Focus. We're a high-growth startup with a busy, remote team. You know how and when to engage or be heads down
  • Technical skills. Swift, SwiftUI

Technical Requirements:

  • Swift Programming Language
  • SwiftUI experience
  • Experience in Multithreading Programming
  • Working with CI/CD infrastructure
  • Experience with Fastlane
  • SOLID principles, the ability to write every single class according to SOLID
  • Experience with Git and understanding of different Git strategies

What We offer:

  • A fast-growing environment where you can help shape the company and product
  • An entrepreneurial crew that supports risk, intuition, and hustle
  • The opportunity to make a big impact in a transformative industry
  • A competitive salary, a collegiate atmosphere, and a commitment to building a great asynchronous culture
  • Work on a product that millions of people use and where daily feedback includes users sharing that they cried when they first found the product because it was so impactful on their lives
  • Support people with learning differences like Dyslexia, ADD, Low Vision, Concussions, Autism, and Second Language Learners, and give reading superpowers to professionals all over the world
  • Work in one of the fastest growing sectors of tech: Intersection of Artificial Intelligence and Audio

The Germany Based Salary range for this role is: 30,000-120,000 USD/Year + Bonus + Stock depending on experience.

Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply.
And don't forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.

Refer them!

title: Senior Software Engineer (Kotlin,Java) (m/f/d)
description:
We're looking for a talented Senior Software Engineer with strong Kotlin skills (or Java and willing to learn Kotlin) to join us in Berlin or Munich.  

In the Foundation Division of FlixTech, our Finance Technology Stream helps the business grow efficiently by delivering smart, compliant, and automated finance solutions. We keep things simple for our internal users so they can spend less time on manual tasks and more time on what matters. The team you will join is not focused on user-facing experiences or polished UIs. Our success is measured by data correctness, consistency, and trustworthiness, even in complex and evolving business scenarios. You'll be part of a self-managed, cross-functional team with a Product Owner and fellow Software Engineers, directly supporting new country launches, new business models, and the continuous evolution of Flix's financial backbone. 

This role is well-suited for someone who enjoys ownership, working close to real business problems, and contributing to the long-term foundations of an international company. If you value collaboration, thoughtful engineering, and building systems that need to be right, not just fast, we'd love to meet you. 

About the Role

  • Design, develop, and maintain backend services using Kotlin 
  • Build and evolve scalable, event-driven systems that process, validate, and expose financial data 
  • Use AI tools such as Claude Code and Copilot conscientiously to assist in faster and higher-quality development
  • Collaborate closely with the Product Owner and Finance stakeholders to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions 
  • Ensure data accuracy, traceability, and auditability across financial and accounting flows 
  • Improve system reliability, observability, and performance for business-critical processes 
  • Contribute to clean code, architectural discussions, and continuous improvement of engineering practices 

About You

  • 5-7 years of experience developing backend systems, with Java or preferably using Kotlin
  • Hands-on experience building backend services using the Spring ecosystem (e.g. Spring Boot, Spring Data) 
  • Experience with event-driven design (e.g. asynchronous processing, messaging, domain events) 
  • Practical experience with cloud platforms (preferably AWS, or similar) 
  • Solid understanding of databases, both NoSQL (e.g. DynamoDB) and/or relational systems 
  • Comfortable working in complex, data-heavy domains (ideally Finance), where investigation, analysis, and precision are key 
  • Communicate clearly in English, open-minded, curious, and motivated to continuously improve both yourself and the systems you work on 

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!  

What We Offer

  • Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family. 
  • Work from (M)Anywhere: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year. 
  • Hybrid work model: We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life. 
  • Wellbeing support: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members. 
  • Learning & Development: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills. 
  • Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career. 

To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations - Flix Career

Why Join Flix?

At Flix, you'll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture - giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path.
As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work.

If you're ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!

title: Cyber Security Engineering Business Manager (m/w/d)
description:
Who are we?

The innovation mission of NVISO is to leverage technology as a pivotal enabler for pioneering cyber security services that have a positive impact on our customers, brand exposure, and bottom line. The Labs team collaborates with all business units by offering an innovation framework, ambassadorship and in-house expertise to transform the best ideas into impactful outcomes. Building a well-oiled machine where people like to work and inspiring all birds to become internal innovators are at the heart of our mission.

Tasks

As the Cyber Security Engineering Business Manager (m/w/d) located in Germany, you drive commercial growth across NVISO's Cyber Security Engineering (CEN) practice globally, spanning both Security Operations Engineering (SOE) and Cyber Security Engineering (CSE) solution lines.

You are the commercial owner of both CEN solution lines: SOC and security operations professional services (SOE) and cloud security engagements (CSE). You combine business development, strategic account management and vendor partnership management. You own the global partnership with Microsoft, NVISO's most strategic technology partner in the CEN space, and act as its primary business-facing interface. You work with Microsoft's account executives, technical specialists and partner development managers to co-develop strategic accounts and unlock cross-border opportunities across Benelux and DACH.

You are the commercial lead on strategic CEN accounts. You shape the multi-year account plan, orchestrate NVISO's specialists across solution lines, and hold the customer relationship at CxO level. Your focus is turning first engagements into multi-year, cross-solution-line commitments rather than one-off wins.

Beyond accounts, you help shape the CEN service portfolio itself. The portfolio is under active development and needs commercial direction: what to productize, how to bundle, how to position against Microsoft's own stack. Typical responsibilities include:

  • Owning business development end-to-end for both CEN solution lines: SOC and security operations professional services (SOE) and cloud security engagements (CSE), including pipeline generation, qualification and conversion;
  • Owning the global Microsoft partnership: joint account planning, co-sell registration, and alignment with Microsoft's segment sellers across regions;
  • Pursuing relevant Microsoft specialization designations and managing funded engagement mechanics on behalf of NVISO;
  • Leading strategic accounts end-to-end, from initial engagement through multi-year expansion across solution lines;
  • Converting project work into recurring managed services as a deliberate commercial motion, not a coincidence of good delivery;
  • Shaping the CEN service portfolio in partnership with practice and delivery leadership, based on market signal and Microsoft's evolving stack;
  • Owning SOWs, RFP responses and complex tender processes across both SOE and CSE, including scoping, pricing, risk allocation and partner-program funding. You have a strong foundation of the service principles, and are able to work efficiently with in-house experts when needed;
  • Representing NVISO externally at CxO level with customers, at partner level with Microsoft, and at industry level in relevant forums;
  • Aligning cross-functionally with delivery, marketing, alliances and finance so commitments made to customers and to Microsoft are deliverable;
  • Coaching and mentoring consultants and managers involved in strategic pursuits, raising the commercial acumen across CEN;
  • Tracking market trends, competitor moves and Microsoft's roadmap, translating them into actionable commercial plays for the practice;
  • Bringing market intelligence back into the organization to influence what NVISO builds next in the CEN portfolio.

You are commercially driven, comfortable at CxO level, and equally at home in a Microsoft joint account planning session as in a customer boardroom. You treat partnership management as a discipline, not a byproduct of doing good work.

Requirements

  • You hold citizenship in one of the 32 NATO member states or the Austrian citizenship;
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field (business, engineering, information security, or equivalent professional experience);
  • A minimum of 10 years of experience in cyber security or adjacent technology consulting;
  • At least 5 years in business development, sales, alliance management or strategic account management within cyber security or IT services;
  • Demonstrable track record of closing multi-year engagements across both SOC professional services and cloud security, including hands-on ownership of SOWs, RFP responses and complex tenders;
  • Deep working knowledge of the Microsoft partner ecosystem: co-sell mechanics, specialization designations, MISA, partner incentive programs and funded engagements;
  • Practical understanding of Azure consumption dynamics and how they shape partner incentives and customer buying behaviour;
  • Established relationships within Microsoft's field sales organization, ideally spanning Benelux and DACH;
  • Strong grasp of the modern Microsoft security stack (Sentinel, Defender XDR, Purview, Entra) sufficient to shape commercial conversations with CISOs;
  • Experience contributing to service portfolio decisions rather than only selling what already exists;
  • Comfort operating in a matrixed environment where success depends on aligning delivery, marketing and alliance stakeholders;
  • Fluent business English; working proficiency in Dutch, French or German is a strong asset given the CEN geographical footprint.

Soft skills

  • Commercially opinionated, with the ability to take and defend a position under pressure from customers, partners and internal stakeholders;
  • Strong executive presence and credibility at CISO, CIO and Managing Partner level;
  • Genuine curiosity about the customer's business, not just their security posture;
  • Ability to hold two agendas at once: what is right for the customer, and what is right for NVISO's commercial position with Microsoft;
  • Discipline to convert conversations into pipeline, and pipeline into recurring revenue, rather than one-off wins;
  • Comfort with ambiguity, including operating on a service portfolio that is still forming;
  • Pragmatic and outcome-oriented, with a bias toward closing rather than deliberating;

About the team

The Land Supply team is a central driver of loveholidays’ success. We are responsible for sourcing all of the bookable land products in our marketplace. Our mission is to secure the broadest range of inventory at the most competitive rates, availability & customer experience quality. We bridge the gap between data-driven yield management and long-term relationship building. As we grow towards our vision of becoming the global leader in package holidays, we are scaling directly contracted inventory and this team is leading that evolution.

 

The impact you’ll have

In this role, you will primarily lead our direct contracting activity across Tunisia & Morocco, with the opportunity to expand into other geographies over time. You will play a critical role not just in direct contracting with hoteliers on behalf of loveholidays, but will contribute strongly to the design of a best-in-class sourcing strategy for our future growth.

Ideally, you will be based within your designated region with strong local market connections. You will be our primary regional presence, leveraging your industry relationships to ensure loveholidays is a preferred partner for major hotel chains and DMCs. You will turn market insights into a sustainable commercial advantage, ensuring our diverse, international customer base always has access to the best rates and exclusive offers.

  • Strategic Portfolio Growth: Define and implement the sourcing strategy, establishing loveholidays as a leader through a direct-contracting model.

  • Relationship Management: Serve as the lead contact for major hotel chains and DMCs, fostering long-term, mutually beneficial partnerships.

  • Commercial Negotiation: Secure market-leading rates, availability and exclusive value-adds that distinguish our brand in all markets - with a particular focus on UK + DE customers.

  • Market Agility: Proactively secure inventory and special offers during peak seasons to ensure we remain the first choice for customers throughout the year.

  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner with Inventory, Yield, and Marketing teams to ensure our supply aligns with demand and our top deals receive high visibility on our platform.

  • Operational Excellence: Manage the end-to-end contracting process, ensuring all agreements are finalized and loaded efficiently.

  • Market Analysis: Maintain a constant pulse on the industry to ensure our pricing and product offering remain highly competitive.

Your skillset:

  • Commercial Expert: You have a strong track record in purchasing within the destination and a deep understanding of commercial performance.

  • Strong Industry Network: You possess an extensive list of established contacts across hotel chains and DMCs in your destination.

Founders Factory builds and funds startups together with exceptional entrepreneurs and the world's leading companies. About the Venture

Every hospital in Europe loses millions to a manual, error-prone coding process that hasn't changed in decades. When a patient is discharged, a trained specialist reads 20–50 pages of clinical documentation and manually translates every diagnosis and procedure into standardised codes. These codes determine how much the hospital gets paid.

In Germany, 17.5 million inpatient cases per year require manual coding. 51.5% of audited cases contain errors. €2.5–3 billion is clawed back annually by insurers through MD audits. 75% of German hospitals ended 2024 in deficit. The coder workforce — several thousand Kodierfachkräfte, each requiring 6–12 months of training at ~€42K salary — cannot scale fast enough.

We are building an autonomous AI coding agent that reads everything the coder reads, reasons from the official coding guidelines (Deutsche Kodierrichtlinien), and enters codes into existing hospital software — in seconds, not 35 minutes. Unlike traditional ML approaches that learn from historical patterns (and inherit their errors), our architecture reasons from the rules at inference time: when InEK publishes annual updates, we swap the guideline document. No retraining. No training data needed. Every code comes with an evidence chain and DKR citation — audit-ready by construction.

The deployment model is equally differentiated: computer-use agents navigate any hospital information system (KIS) via VPN, exactly as a human coder would. No API integration. No IT burden on the hospital. Deployment in days, not months. Deep EHR integration follows as relationships deepen, creating switching costs.

The AI clinical coding market is ~$3B today, projected to reach $10–11B by 2035. In Germany, the addressable market is €150–400M for AI coding software alone, with an additional ~€1.6B/year in audit clawbacks that better coding recovers. US players (CodaMetrix, Fathom, Nym) have raised $600M+ but are built for American codes and EHRs. Parallel has proven the model in France ($23.5M raised, computer-use approach validated) but hasn't entered Germany. The German G-DRG system is wide open.

Find out more about the venture concept here.

We don't just fund ideas — we co-build them. Join as Founder & CEO and get access to a full-stack venture studio offering designed to give you the best possible start:

    • Embedded studio team throughout: a full time venture builder, with support from a broader team consisting of a studio lead and growth marketer. Founders build; the Studio supports.

    • On-demand access to specialist support across data science, applied AI, fundraising, legal, finance, PR and commercial partnerships

    • Dedicated network access from day one

    Months 6–12 (Accelerator / Spinout)

    • At incorporation, the founding team will receive 70% equity in a new company set up for the venture, and the Studio 15%, both subscribed at nominal value. The remaining 15% is reserved as an employee option pool.

    • Accelerator support: a dedicated squad covering growth, product and fundraising, plus continued access to shared services

Jobs to be Done

As Founder & CEO, you will be responsible for turning a strong thesis into a scaled, defensible business.

  • Define the wedge. Decide which clinical specialty, which KIS vendor, and which hospital segment you attack first — and whether v1 focuses on coding alone or includes insurer challenge defence.

  • Build the coding engine. Architect an LLM + rules engine that reasons from DKR guidelines, handles ICD-10-GM and OPS codes, and produces audit-defensible output with evidence chains.

  • Ship via computer-use. Deploy the first agent that navigates a hospital KIS like a human coder — VPN, user account, days to deploy — and prove accuracy against the human baseline.

  • Win RBK as a reference site. Run a retrospective analysis on historical cases to quantify revenue left on the table, then convert to a live pilot.

  • Navigate regulation. Build for BSI C5 Type 2 certification, GDPR compliance, and EU AI Act readiness — these are table stakes, not afterthoughts.

  • Build the agent factory. Once coding earns trust, extend to billing, admissions, CDI — each new agent on the same infrastructure, compounding switching costs.

Your Ideal Experience

  • Unique market insight or a "top 1%" advantage in clinical coding, hospital revenue cycle, health-tech AI, or German healthcare IT.

Most importantly, you are motivated by building the system that automates the most cognitively demanding administrative process in healthcare — and turns every hospital into a customer for an expanding suite of AI agents.

This is your company. We're here to help.

description:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

About the role

As a Senior Frontend Engineer on our Website team, you'll be a co-owner of the platform behind synthesia.io: the component library, content model and rendering stack that every page on our marketing site is built from. You'll shape direction and make key technical decisions with the team, likely with a focus area of your own but context across the whole system. This is a hands-on engineering role, and your primary output is high-quality component and schema code, plus the tooling that lets others build with it.

Millions of people visit synthesia.io every month, and it is one of the main ways we win new customers. That comes with real responsibility. The decisions you make are seen at scale, and we set the quality bar accordingly.

The defining challenge of this role is composability: a marketing site that marketers, and increasingly AI agents, can build pages with, without breaking design, performance or SEO.

You can expect to:

  • Build, scale and evolve our section library: the Astro components, Sanity schemas and design tokens that let us compose marketing pages consistently and accessibly.

  • Own the content model. Design schemas that resist misuse, so an editor, or an agent, can build a page that is correct by construction rather than correct by review.

  • Take Figma component specs all the way to production: responsive across mobile, tablet and desktop, accessible by default, matching design intent precisely.

  • Extend the platform for AI-assisted development, so coding agents can generate on-brand, on-spec sections from a design spec as reliably as a person can.

  • Own SEO integrity as a first-class engineering concern: canonicals, sitemaps, structured data, redirects, and no traffic cliffs on launch.

  • Raise the bar on engineering standards across the website surface: thorough code review, patterns others can follow, and tests around the parts that actually break.

  • Maintain and extend localisation across nine locales and a translation pipeline, so the system works for a global audience.

  • Shape the technical direction of the website platform over the next 6 to 12 months, and champion its adoption with the people who publish on it.

What we're looking for

  • At least five (5) years as a software engineer, including three (3) at senior level, building front end for content-driven or marketing platforms.

  • Real ownership of a content model in Sanity. You've designed schemas other people had to live with, and you have opinions about references vs. embedded objects, when a variant belongs in the schema versus at runtime, and how to stop a section library sprawling. GROQ and Portable Text are familiar territory.

  • Deep front-end expertise: expert HTML, CSS and TypeScript, with a strong command of component API design and the developer experience of a shared library.

  • You can work end to end. Comfortable owning the server side as well as the front end: SSR, serverless and edge runtimes, API routes, a SQL database, secrets and CI. You should be able to take a feature from schema to component to the route that serves it without handing off, and be happy debugging something that only reproduces in production.

  • Solid understanding of responsive design, cross-browser compatibility and web performance, and comfortable building to WCAG 2.2 AA. Accessibility is part of your definition of done, not a separate pass.

  • You care that marketing sites are measured, on performance, SEO, analytics events and conversion, and you're happy being accountable to those numbers.

  • A strong sense of craft and attention to detail, and the judgement to balance design intent against engineering constraints.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills. You explain your reasoning, review generously, and treat levelling up the people around you as part of the job.

Nice to haves

  • Prior experience working on a large SaaS marketing website, at real traffic and with real stakes attached.

  • Astro, or another islands or static-site framework.

  • Cloudflare Workers, or another edge or serverless platform.

  • Experience with AWS Lambda.

  • Tailwind CSS v4, and experience working from a token-based design system.

  • Experience, or strong interest, in making component libraries and content models consumable by AI agents.

  • A strong design sensibility: an eye for visual detail and the judgement to push back on and improve design decisions, not just build them.

  • Experience with localisation and internationalisation at scale for a global audience.

  • Analytics and tag management implementation: dataLayer events, server-side tagging, getting attribution right without hurting performance.

Our culture

At Synthesia we're passionate about building, not talking, planning or politicising. We strive to hire the smartest, kindest and most unrelenting people and let them do their best work without distractions. Our work principles serve as our charter for how we make decisions, give feedback and structure our work to empower everyone to go as fast as possible. You can find out more about these principles here.

  • 60 min call with leadership, focused on examples of collaboration, growth, and the details of your future team.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:

As the first Customer Success Manager in this area, you will own the end-to-end post-sale experience for a portfolio of customers that includes some of the world’s most sophisticated cyber threat intelligence teams and investigators, national security agencies, and financial crime teams. Your mandate is not just to manage accounts—you will help establish the playbook, define what success looks like, and drive a product-led growth motion that turns new customers into long-term, expanding partners.

The impact you will have:

  • Build and ship a v1 onboarding playbook within the first 30 days—a practical, working version built from early customer engagements that can be iterated as you learn what drives adoption across international customer segments.

  • Identify and scope the highest-impact PLG play within 60 days by working backwards from expansion targets, focusing on the one or two use cases most likely to drive consumption across the customer base.

  • Run executive business reviews and QBRs with senior stakeholders at government agencies and financial institutions internationally—building the trust and credibility that turns TRM from a vendor into a mission-critical partner.

  • Partner with ADs on expansion plays, co-own NRR targets, and build the structured path to proving value for every customer with an expiring or at-risk contract.

  • Close the feedback loop between customers and Product—synthesize adoption blockers, feature gaps, and new use-case opportunities into prioritized, actionable input that informs the roadmap.

What we're looking for:

  • Background in cyber or cyber threat intelligence, intelligence agencies, financial crime investigations, or regulatory and compliance environments.

You can show the workflow, explain the data logic, and articulate where human judgment stays in the loop.

  • A high level of independence—you set your own agenda, operate without needing constant direction, and ship v1 before you have all the answers.

  • Strong executive presence—you can run a QBR with a senior government stakeholder or financial institution executive and command the room through substance, not just polish.

  • Experience supporting international customers, with the ability to navigate regional, cultural, and time-zone differences.

About the Team:

  • This team focuses on TRM’s AI-driven Intel platform, supporting investigators and cyber teams working on complex cases involving cyber threats.

  • This is the first Customer Success hire dedicated to international customers—you will help build the function from the ground up, with high autonomy, direct access to leadership, and meaningful influence on how TRM approaches customer success globally.

  • The broader TRM CS organization operates distributed, not distant—async-first communication through Slack, strong documentation, and intentional synchronous time for key decisions.

  • You will work directly with the Head of Customer Success and Patrick South, CRO, with close day-to-day collaboration with international Sales teams and Product.

Team Operating Rhythms:

  • As a globally distributed team, members work across multiple time zones. This role will primarily align its working hours and customer coverage with international markets, with flexibility to collaborate across regions when needed.

  • Our Customer Success team is fully remote, thriving on asynchronous communication and collaboration through Slack channels and detailed documentation. We hold weekly customer syncs, biweekly health syncs, join our associated POD calls, and regularly engage with customers across international markets. As experts in our craft, we focus on providing support, driving value, and building meaningful relationships with our customers as trusted advisors. We are on the front lines of TRM, ensuring our customers get the most out of the product and bringing valuable insights back to the team.

  • The team moves fast and iterates—v1 ships before it is perfect, and feedback is expected to be direct and specific.

On-Call Responsibilities:

  • End-to-End Ownership: While there is no formal hourly rotation, you will be the primary lead for your area and responsible for customer success across international markets. This requires a high degree of agency and a commitment to seeing mission-critical tasks through to resolution, including the flexibility to handle urgent needs outside of standard hours or on weekends when they arise.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

  • Within 30 days of joining, you ship a working v1 onboarding playbook built from your first 2–3 accounts—not a slide deck, but a live document with measurable adoption benchmarks that the account team is already using to set customer expectations.

  • Within 6 weeks, you share a draft success-metrics framework at 50% complete with the account team and key customers to validate direction—getting real signal on what drives credit consumption before investing further in building out the full playbook.

  • Within 60 days, you identify and scope the highest-impact PLG play by working backwards from expansion targets—presenting a concrete recommendation to leadership on which use case to prioritize and why, grounded in actual account data from international customers.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves quickly. We are a high velocity, high ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly as we experiment and iterate

  • Work that often requires operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. At the same time, many people find this work deeply rewarding.   • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

Silvernova ist in 15 Monaten von 0 auf 400+ Anwaltskanzleien und 1 Mio € ARR gewachsen – und wächst weiter mit hohem Tempo. Unsere Investoren sind hochkarätige VCs und Partner von renommierten Anwaltskanzleien wie YPOG, CMS und Neon.

Wir bieten einen KI-Associate an, der in der Akte des Anwalts denkt – optimiert für komplexe Aktenarbeit in der Sachverhaltserfassung, rechtlichen Bewertung und Schriftsatzerstellung. Damit sparen Anwältinnen und Anwälte täglich bis zu 4 Stunden Arbeitszeit.

Warum diese Rolle jetzt entscheidend ist: Wir stehen am Anfang unserer nächsten Wachstumsphase – von 400 auf 4.000 Kanzleien. Jede Woche starten neue Kanzleien mit Silvernova, und ob sie erfolgreich werden, entscheidet sich in den ersten Wochen: bei Einrichtung, Onboarding und den ersten Fragen. Unsere Kunden spiegeln uns regelmäßig, dass die persönliche Betreuung ein Grund ist, warum sie bei Silvernova sind. Genau diesen Standard hältst und skalierst du.

Damit wirst du das Gesicht von Silvernova für unsere Kunden – von KI-erfahrenen Anwält:innen bis hin zu Neueinsteigern – und die zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Entwicklung, Sales und Customer Success: Niemand im Team weiß besser als du, was unsere Kunden bewegt. Bei uns ist Betreuung kein Cost Center. Sie ist Teil des Produkts.

Du arbeitest gerne direkt mit Menschen, machst Dinge konstant richtig gut und willst mitprägen, wie eine ganze Branche mit KI arbeitet? Dann lass uns unbedingt sprechen!

Aufgaben

Du sorgst dafür, dass jede Kanzlei erfolgreich mit Silvernova startet und im Alltag zuverlässig betreut ist.

  • Onboarding: Du übernimmst neue Kanzleien direkt nach Vertragsabschluss vom Sales-Team und bringst sie live – Installation, Einrichtung, Anbindung an die Kanzleisoftware – und führst die Teams in die Arbeit mit dem KI-Associate ein. Dein Ziel: Jede Kanzlei arbeitet nach wenigen Wochen souverän mit Silvernova.
  • Support: Du beantwortest die Supportanfragen unserer Kunden – per E-Mail, Telefon und Videocall. Schnell, verbindlich, in verständlicher Sprache. Du bleibst dran, bis das Problem gelöst ist.
  • Wissen aufbauen: Du bereitest aus deinen Erfahrungen mit den Kunden eine strukturierte Wissenssammlung auf und baust unser Hilfe-Center aus – so machst du häufige Fragen dauerhaft seltener.
  • Stimme des Kunden: Du erkennst wiederkehrende Muster, priorisierst Verbesserungspotenziale und gibst strukturiertes Feedback direkt an Entwicklung und Sales – so trägst du aktiv zur Weiterentwicklung unseres Produkts bei.

Qualifikation

Wichtiger als eine bestimmte Anzahl an Berufsjahren sind uns Zuverlässigkeit, Lernfähigkeit und Freude am Kundenkontakt. Das solltest du mitbringen:

  • KI-Verständnis: Du verstehst die Möglichkeiten und Grenzen moderner KI-Systeme und kannst Kunden bei ihrer täglichen Nutzung kompetent begleiten.
  • Schnelle Auffassungsgabe: Du denkst dich zügig in neue Softwarelösungen ein. Nach kurzer Zeit entwickelst du dich zu einer der zentralen Ansprechpersonen für unsere Kunden. Optimalerweise kennst du dich bereits mit CRM-Tools wie Intercom oder HubSpot aus und weißt, wie sich wiederkehrende Anfragen automatisieren lassen.
  • Stark im Umgang mit Menschen: Du kommunizierst freundlich, klar und geduldig – und erklärst Technik so, dass Anwältinnen und Anwälte sie sofort verstehen. Unsere Kunden sind übrigens ausgesprochen angenehme Ansprechpartner: Sie schätzen gute Betreuung und sagen das auch.
  • Sorgfalt & Struktur: Du arbeitest strukturiert, dokumentierst sauber und lässt nichts liegen. Du ziehst Zufriedenheit daraus, Dinge konstant gut zu machen.
  • Ownership: Du recherchierst selbstständig, probierst Lösungen aus und weißt, wann du Unterstützung hinzuziehst.
  • Kanzleierfahrung ist ein Pluspunkt, keine Voraussetzung: Wer als ReFa, ReNo oder in der Kanzleiorganisation gearbeitet hat, kennt die Abläufe unserer Kunden aus eigener Erfahrung. Genauso stark: Erfahrung im technischen Support oder IT-Service.
  • Sprachen: Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau, Englisch fließend (C1).

Wenn du nicht alle Punkte erfüllst: Bewirb dich trotzdem. Uns interessiert Potenzial, nicht Perfektion – im Zweifel entscheidet ein Gespräch, kein Lebenslauf.

Benefits

  • Startup in der entscheidenden Phase: Du kommst mitten in unserer Skalierungsphase an Bord – und erlebst hautnah, wie ein VC-finanziertes Unternehmen wächst. Legal AI ist eine der spannendsten Branchen gerade, und du prägst sie an vorderster Front mit.
  • Gestaltungsfreiheit: Direkter Zugang zum Gründerteam, kurze Entscheidungswege – dein Feedback landet nicht in einem Backlog, sondern im nächsten Release.
  • Sichtbare Wirkung: Du hörst jeden Tag direkt von Kunden, was deine Arbeit bewirkt.
  • Klarer Wachstumspfad: Der Bereich Onboarding & Support wächst mit dem Unternehmen – du hast die Chance, ihn von Anfang an mitzuprägen und mit ihm zu wachsen.
  • Teamkultur: Dich erwartet ein dynamisches, ambitioniertes Team mit einem freundschaftlichen, wertschätzenden Miteinander und regelmäßigen Team-Events.
  • Office-First mit Verlässlichkeit: Weil wir an echten Austausch glauben, verbringen wir mindestens 3 Tage pro Woche gemeinsam in unserem Münchener Büro – die restliche Woche gestaltest du flexibel.
  • Wellpass inklusive: Zugang zu hunderten Sport-, Fitness- und Wellnessangeboten.

Werde jetzt Customer Success & Growth Manager bei Silvernova und sorge dafür, dass tausende Kanzleien erfolgreich mit KI arbeiten. Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung – unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter oder Lebensweg.

Zu den Bewerbungsfragen: Kurze, präzise Antworten genügen. Uns interessieren konkrete Erfahrungen und klare Gedanken.

title: Senior Cloud Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
About us

Since 2000, has been making shipping simpler, more transparent, and more efficient for businesses. With our platforms and , companies can quickly compare and directly book their daily shipping needs. By bringing together a wide range of carriers on our platforms, we combine modern technology with personal service.

Across several locations in Europe, our teams work every day to simplify shipping processes in a sustainable way. We believe in open collaboration and fast decision-making. That’s why we are looking for people who take ownership, contribute ideas, and want to actively shape the future with us.

Your mission

We are looking for a Senior Cloud Engineer (m/f/d) to strengthen our Tech team at the earliest possible start date.

In this key role, you will play a pivotal part in shaping and advancing our shipping platforms from a technological perspective.

Your mission is to drive the development of a future-proof, highly available cloud architecture, optimize the performance of our core applications, and ensure maximum system reliability through robust CI/CD pipelines and state-of-the-art observability solutions. You'll have the opportunity to actively influence technology decisions, elevate our IT security to the next level, and expand our infrastructure as a key enabler of the company's continued growth.

Your Key Responsibilities

  • Cloud Architecture & Networking: You design, build, and scale our cloud infrastructure. This includes managing core networking components such as VPCs, routing, DNS, and load balancing, while ensuring secure, highly available connectivity across our locations.
  • Core Application Infrastructure: You take ownership of the infrastructure behind our business-critical applications, including deployment, hosting optimization, and performance tuning. Your primary focus will be a complex Java application and a large-scale PHP platform.
  • Monitoring & Observability: You ensure end-to-end visibility across our systems by designing, implementing, and continuously enhancing our monitoring and observability stack (e.g., Grafana). You also establish effective alerting to enable proactive issue detection and resolution.
  • Technology Evaluation & Scalability: With a current focus on AWS, you optimize our platforms for high availability—for example, by integrating Redis for session caching and ensuring reliable WebSocket connectivity. At the same time, you keep our long-term goal of maintaining a cloud-agnostic architecture in mind.
  • Security & Best Practices: You evaluate and implement modern cloud-native solutions to enhance our secrets management and establish industry best practices for infrastructure security across our engineering processes.
  • Process Reliability & CI/CD: You design, build, and maintain highly automated CI/CD pipelines to enable reliable, efficient deployments. You also implement automated recovery mechanisms that ensure interrupted processes can resume seamlessly.

What you need to succeed

You have a structured, methodical, and self-driven way of working, backed by several years of hands-on experience in cloud infrastructure administration, for example as a Cloud Engineer, Platform Engineer, or DevOps Engineer.

With your collaborative mindset, excellent communication skills, and approachable personality, you confidently work across teams and stakeholders, acting as a trusted advisor on infrastructure-related topics. You take a holistic approach to problem-solving while maintaining a strong focus on compliance requirements and the highest standards of data security.

Your (technical) profile

  • Linux Administration: Proven hands-on experience administering, maintaining, and troubleshooting Linux-based systems.

Über uns
Hausverwalter.ai ist eine All-in-One-Plattform für Hausverwaltungen, mit Funktionen wie Inbox, CRM, Dokumenten, Telefonie, Video Calls, Team Chat und KI-Agenten. Unsere Mission ist es, alles zu automatisieren, was ein Hausverwalter tut.

Über die Rolle
Unsere Plattform ist von Tag eins an agentisch gedacht. Bevor wir überhaupt die UI geplant haben, haben wir geplant, wie Agenten mit der Software arbeiten. Denk dran – unser Ziel ist, die ganze Branche zu automatisieren, und das meinen wir ernst.
Heute gibt es für fast alles, was der Nutzer in der UI machen kann, ein Agenten-Tool, und der Co-Pilot (der tägliche Assistent des Nutzers) kann alles für ihn übernehmen, sogar den Dark Mode an- und ausschalten.
Aber der Co-Pilot ist erst der Anfang. Die eigentliche Herausforderung sind die autonomen Agenten. Dazu unten mehr.

Woran du arbeiten wirst

  • Inbox-Agents: Autonome Agenten, die anspringen, sobald in einem Ticket etwas Neues passiert. Kunden trainieren sie selbst ODER nehmen einfach eine der Vorlagen, die du für sie baust. Diese Agenten können heute schon komplette komplexe Abläufe allein übernehmen und sind einer der Hauptgründe, warum sich Kunden für unsere Software interessieren. Aber wann sollte ein Agent an einen Menschen abgeben, statt selbst zu Ende zu machen? Wie stellen wir sicher, dass er sich an den Prozess hält? Das sind deine Fragen.

  • Harness Engineering: Der Agent hat über 100 Tools. Aber er muss eine Anfrage so verstehen, wie ein Hausverwalter sie versteht, und nicht so, wie die Begriffe außerhalb der Branche klingen. Was gehört in den System Prompt, was in Skills?

  • Knowledge Base: Unsere Plattform hat eine eigene Knowledge Base, ähnlich wie Notion. Komplett selbst gebaut und gedacht als kollektives Gehirn des Unternehmens. Aber sollte die KI auch von selbst „lernen"? Und wenn ja, wann? Und wie machen wir die Suche in der Knowledge Base besser — über bessere Tools, System Prompts oder Skills?

  • Voice-Agents: Dieselben Agenten, nur am Telefon — auf LiveKit gebaut, die Anrufe genauso abwickeln wie unsere Text-Agenten Tickets.

  • LLM Infrastructure. Das richtige Modell für die jeweilige Aufgabe wählen, per Caching und Streaming die Latenz drücken, bei Provider-Ausfällen sauber neu versuchen, Context kompakt halten, die RAG-Suche optimieren, Usage über alle Provider tracken, Kosten senken und mit Evals prüfen, was wirklich besser ist.

Unser minimalistischer Tech Stack
Alles ist TypeScript. Vom Datenbankschema bis ins Frontend.
Backend: Convex (Datenbank & Serverless Functions)
Frontend: Next.js, React, Tailwind, shadcn/ui
Technologien, die dir begegnen werden: Vercel AI SDK, Convex Agent Component

title: Senior / Staff Product Engineer
description:
About Passionfroot

We are backed by leading investors including Insight Partners, Creandum, Supernode and founders and operators from Cursor, Anthropic, n8n and more. We're expanding fast across New York, Europe, and Brazil - and we're just getting started.

We’re still a small team, which means the people who join now will have an outsized influence on the product, the engineering culture, and the company we become.

About the role

We’re looking for a Senior or Staff Product Engineer to help build the next generation of Passionfroot.

You’ll work across the full stack on both our core platform and Zest, our AI Campaign Manager for creator marketing. That could mean designing a new workflow for managing creator campaigns, making collaboration data feel instant, or turning models, search, and product context into a reliable AI experience that customers can trust.

We don’t separate “AI engineering” from “product engineering.” AI is becoming part of how the product works, but great product fundamentals still matter: understanding the user, shaping the problem, choosing the right architecture, building a thoughtful experience, and operating it reliably in production.

You’ll work closely with the founders, design, and customers to take important problems from early exploration to shipped product.

We’re a team of six engineers, and staying small is deliberate. It means you can have an idea on Monday and have customers using it by Thursday—without layers of sprint ceremonies or alignment meetings in between. The flip side is real ownership: you need to exercise strong judgment, communicate your decisions, and think through their consequences rather than wait for someone else to catch them.

What you’ll do

  • Own meaningful product areas from problem definition through architecture, implementation, launch, and iteration.

  • Build customer-facing features across our marketplace, campaign management, collaboration, payments, analytics, and creator workflows.

  • Help make Zest an indispensable part of how modern companies run creator-led growth.

  • Turn foundation models into structured, reliable product experiences—not just impressive prototypes.

  • Work on intelligent workflows involving agents, tools, retrieval, search, recommendations, and generated interfaces.

  • Develop the evaluations, observability, and feedback loops needed to understand whether AI features are genuinely useful.

  • Work closely with design to create experiences that are fast, intuitive, and polished.

  • Talk directly with customers and translate ambiguous needs into simple product decisions.

  • Make pragmatic architectural choices that balance speed, quality, maintainability, and performance.

  • Improve the systems and engineering practices that help a small team ship reliably at high velocity.

  • At Staff level, provide technical direction across projects, raise the engineering bar, and help other engineers make better decisions.

What we’re looking for

  • Significant experience building and shipping high-quality, customer-facing software. 5+ years is a useful guide, but the scope and quality of your work matter more than the number.

  • Strong TypeScript and React fundamentals, with experience working across the full stack.

  • A track record of independently driving complex features or products from an ambiguous starting point to measurable customer impact. When you encounter a blocker, you investigate, communicate, and find another path forward without waiting to be managed.

  • Strong product and technical judgment. You care about what should be built, how it should feel, and whether it actually solves the problem. You can distinguish between problems that need a sophisticated system and problems that need a simple, well-executed solution.

  • Experience building with LLMs or other applied AI systems in production.

  • An understanding of the challenges behind reliable AI products: evaluation, context, retrieval, model behavior, latency, cost, observability, and failure modes.

  • Clear, proactive communication and the ability to collaborate effectively in a remote environment.

  • Care for software craftsmanship without losing sight of momentum and customer outcomes.

Our technology

Passionfroot is built primarily in TypeScript across the full stack.

Our core product uses React, Remix, PostgreSQL, Prisma, and Zero sync for real-time product experiences. Our AI systems use foundation models from multiple providers alongside the AI SDK, Typesense, and Laminar for search, agent workflows, evaluations, and observability.

You don’t need experience with everything we use. We care more about strong fundamentals, relevant product experience, and your ability to learn quickly.

What success looks like

Within your first months, you will have:

  • Developed a deep understanding of creator-led growth and the problems our customers face.

  • Taken ownership of a major product or technical area with limited oversight.

  • Improved how we build, evaluate, and operate AI-powered functionality.

  • Earned the trust of the team through reliable execution and clear communication.

  • Helped us make better product and technical decisions beyond your immediate projects.

Our interview process

We want the process to be useful, respectful, and representative of how we actually work. We don’t use take-home challenges or algorithmic whiteboard interviews.

The process typically includes:

  1. A short introductory call.

  2. A conversation with Lorenzo about your experience, ambitions, and the work you are most proud of.

  3. A technical walkthrough of a project you know deeply, focused on the decisions and trade-offs you made.

  4. A collaborative product and technical problem-solving session with members of the team.

  5. A paid work trial based on a realistic problem, which can be completed flexibly around your current commitments.

  6. References and offer.

We aim to complete the process within one to two weeks.

What we offer

  • Remote-first work with the option to work together in Berlin if you are local.

  • 25 days of paid vacation, plus local public holidays.

  • Regular team events and off-sites—past destinations include Mallorca, Barcelona, the South of France, Berlin, and the Baltic Sea.

title: SAP Developer
description:
About InCycling

Every year €26 billion worth of perfectly usable chemical raw materials are getting destroyed, generating millions of tonnes of avoidable CO₂ emissions and hazardous waste, not because they lack value, but because no system exists to capture it. InCycling is changing that. We are building a cloud-native AI-driven B2B platform with deep SAP integration, automated regulatory compliance workflows, and ML-based supply-vs-demand matching for scalable surplus chemical management. We are live with a couple of global DAX-tier enterprise pilot across 10+ production sites in 10+ countries and 3 continents with over 600 tonnes of surplus chemicals already in our deal pipeline. You would be joining at the moment where the foundation you build will define how the platform scales.

Tasks

The role

InCycling helps pharmaceutical and chemical manufacturers trade their surplus materials instead of disposing of them. The InCycling SAP Add-on is what makes that work inside a customer's own S/4HANA system: it surfaces slow-moving and surplus batches, supports quality and compliance assessment, and moves material through its selling, shipping and billing lifecycle — all synchronized with our platform via BTP and AWS middleware. The add-on is currently built with an external implementation partner and will be handed over to us; this role takes on its technical health and growth from there. As more manufacturers come on board, each brings their own SAP landscape and processes, so the work spans steady maintenance, customer-specific extension, on-site setup, and close collaboration with both our platform backend team and the customers' SAP teams.

What you'll do

  • Take over the add-on after handover from the implementation partner and grow into full technical ownership
  • Maintain and extend the add-on's freestyle Fiori app (SAPUI5) — filter panels, multi-select tables, Flexible Column Layout, object pages and platform embedding
  • Extend the underlying ABAP RAP services (CDS entities, behavior definitions/implementations) and the OData V4 services the app consumes
  • Work across the S/4HANA backend: custom tables, batch/material status logic and the status-transition rules that govern it
  • Support the BTP integration flows that exchange batch and material data with our platform via the AWS middleware
  • Set up and deploy the add-on in customer systems, working alongside each customer's SAP team
  • Provide technical support to customers — troubleshooting, debugging, resolving integration issues
  • Implement customer-specific configurations and adaptations
  • Track work in Jira and document solutions and technical decisions in Confluence
  • Collaborate with the platform backend team on API contract changes and improvements

Requirements

What we're looking for

  • 1+ years working with SAP development
  • Hands-on SAPUI5 / freestyle Fiori development (JavaScript, XML views, OData V4 consumption) — comfortable extending an existing app, not only generating one from a template
  • ABAP knowledge, with willingness to deepen RAP (CDS views, behavior definitions) and integration patterns
  • Familiarity with S/4HANA architecture
  • Customer-oriented mindset for technical support and on-site collaboration
  • Good problem-solving skills and attention to detail
  • Clear communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Nice to have

  • Experience with MM, SD or QM modules
  • Exposure to SAP BTP and integration/eventing
  • Experience with add-on delivery / transport management (e.g. SAP Add-on Assembly Kit)
  • Experience with Java/Spring Boot (our platform side)

Benefits

We offer

  • The opportunity to build a digital platform from the ground up, influencing key architectural and engineering decisions;
  • A small, highly collaborative team, fast decision-making. Direct mentorship from experienced data scientists and engineers (you won’t be learning from docs alone!), direct access to founders.
  • A mission-driven product contributing to the circular economy by reducing waste and CO₂ emissions in the chemical industry.
  • A pragmatic engineering culture with modern tools, including AI-assisted development.
  • A flexible hybrid working setup and a culture built on ownership, collaboration, and continuous learning.
  • Starting as a 24-month engagement tied to our funding cycle, with every intention of building a long-term journey together as InCycling grows.
  • Urban Sports Club membership as a company health benefit or a mobility budget.
  • Access to corporate employee benefits platforms with regularly changing monthly offers and discounts.

We welcome candidates from all backgrounds, who believe in our mission. If you do not match 100% of the requirements, but believe you can do the job, please apply: perfect candidates do not exist, but wonderful colleagues do.

title: Manager, Solutions Consultants, DACH
description:
Who We Are

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.

Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.

About the Role:

The Solutions Consultant Manager is the person who makes our GTM motion real on the ground. As an in-region leader directly managing a team of Solutions Consultants, you'll own your team's full commercial output—new logo, expansion, and renewals—and be accountable for both the results and the quality of execution that produces them.

This isn't a traditional pipeline-management role. The best SC Managers are coaches first: they know what a great first meeting looks like, can watch a live build and tell a rep exactly what to change, and build the operating rhythm and inspection cadence that makes consistent execution possible across the team. If you're a builder who loves developing people as much as winning deals—and you want to lead a regional team in a go-to-market model that's genuinely new—this is the role.

This role will be based in Munich, Germany. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.

What You'll Achieve:

  • Own the commercial performance of your team across new logo ARR, expansion ARR, and UBP outcomes—accountable for both the headline numbers and the quality of execution that drives them

  • Coach SCs on the GTM builder motion: what great looks like in a first meeting (workflow diagnosis, current → future architecture), a second meeting (live build in Notion + value narrative), and through the full cycle to adoption hand-off

  • Contribute to and participate in the regional operating cadence: weekly pipeline reviews, deal support sessions, call reviews against the motion quality rubric, and forecast calls with senior leadership

  • Hire, onboard, and certify new SCs to the GTM builder motion—driving readiness from ramp through consistent execution, and managing performance with clarity when expectations aren't met

  • Partner with the regional BDR manager on pipeline strategy, outbound targeting, and qualification standards to ensure the team's book of business is healthy and growing

  • Partner with Outcomes leadership on adoption hand-offs, at-risk account management, and renewal strategy—owning the overall commercial arc for the region while collaborating on the execution that follows close

  • Represent your team or region in leadership forums with clear signal on what's working, what needs investment, and where execution is breaking down

Skills You'll Need to Bring:

  • Track record as a quota-carrying B2B seller with direct experience in workflow design, live demos, or technical sales—you can coach the builder motion because you've run it yourself

  • Frontline sales management experience: built an operating cadence, ran performance management, and developed talent from onboarding through consistent overperformance

  • Strong coaching orientation: you can watch a demo or deal review and identify specifically what to change—not just whether the outcome was good, but why, and what the rep should do differently next time

  • Commercial instincts at the team level: able to read pipeline health, identify risk early, and drive urgency across a team without micromanaging individual deals

  • You don't need to be an AI expert, but you're curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.

  • Fluency in English and German.

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience selling or managing in a consumption or usage-based business where adoption signals matter as much as closed ARR

  • Track record building high-performing regional teams from an early stage: hiring to profile, structured onboarding, certification, and performance management

  • Experience in a shared account ownership model—able to navigate the SC/CSA hand-offs and hold the commercial arc across the full customer lifecycle

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is €260,000 per year.

By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy.

#LI-Onsite

A Note on AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.

Equal Opportunity & Accommodations

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.

Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

title: Climate Success Manager (full-time internship)
description:
👷🏻‍♀️ What we do 👷🏻‍♀️

At Emidat, we are building the first climate-native product management system for building material manufacturers. We aim to decarbonise building materials, making up 11% of global GHG emissions. We collect data from physical production processes, generate a digital product passport with verified environmental data and make it usable along the value chain. In short: One solution to assess, design, buy, sell and manage products - with environmental impact at the core.

With this, we are building the digital infrastructure to make it faster, easier, and more sustainable to build the world around us.

Find out more about us, the team and our values here.

What you will work on

Your mission

Join our Climate Success team as a full-time Intern and support our customers across the entire user journey - from onboarding to day-to-day support to technical questions. Your focus will be twofold: creating real value for our customers, as well as driving internal processes within the CS team to make us more efficient. Along the way, you'll gain hands-on insight into product management (including our Digital Twin area), LCA engineering, and how new applications get built into an existing product. You'll also work closely with our LCA Domain Experts, giving you exposure to the technical foundation of our product.

At the same time, you'll dive into the building materials industry itself: getting to know manufacturers of cement, steel, windows, construction chemicals, asphalt, electronic building equipment and many more - and understanding how differently each of them approaches EPDs and LCAs.

During your internship, you will

  • Support the CS team across all stages of the customer journey, from onboarding to ongoing support (including, participating in customer meetings & visits, answering customer requests, validating EPD and LCA’s)

  • Contribute to and help shape internal processes (i.e automating workflows of data transfers and customer communications, analysing user behaviour)

  • Own an individual project end-to-end, driving it forward independently within your time at Emidat (e.g. improvement of usability of Emidat platform with customer knowledge & insights gained through internship).

  • Get direct insight into how CS, Product, and our LCA Domain Experts collaborate.

  • Build a broad understanding of the building materials industry and its sustainability requirements.

What you should bring to this role

Minimum Requirements

  • Languages: Business fluent in German (C2/Native) and English (C1/C2)

  • Project Management: Demonstrated previous experience taking projects from start to finish - owning, structuring and driving the measurable outcomes.

  • AI native: Hands-on experience using AI tools to automate a workflow, analyse data, or accelerate a deliverable — comfortable experimenting with new AI features as they emerge.

  • Demonstrated Interest: Relevant work experience, education or interest in the sector. Demonstrated through engagement with climate topics, the building materials / construction industry, or how software can capture complex technical processes.

Nice to have's

  • Languages: Business fluency in an additional European language (Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, Turkish).

  • Experience: Previous experience in a customer-facing role (i.e Customer Success, Support, Onboarding, Sales, or Consulting) where you managed relationships or solved problems in real time.

How we support you

Your team lead will be

  • Sina Dupslaff Zamorano (Team Lead, Climate Success)

You will work with

  • Linus Müller, Climate Success Manager

  • Timon Rückel, Climate Success Manager

  • Vadzim Kvachynski, Climate Success Manager

  • Anna Sander-Titgemeyer, LCA Expert

  • Jona van der Ham, LCA Expert

  • Areeba Qureshi, LCA Expert

Meet the rest of the team HERE.

See our full benefits HERE, including:

  • 💸 Attractive compensation package

  • 🏖️ 25 days of vacation days per year (pro rata)

  • 📚 €500 Learning Budget

 

Admin:

  • Start date: As soon as possible

  • Role type: Full time internship.

  • Location: Munich, Germany

As a senior commercial leader, the role acts as a trusted advisor to hotel owners and asset managers, delivering transparent, data-driven insights and ensuring that all commercial strategies support both short-term performance and long-term financial returns.

description:
About ScholarshipOwl

ScholarshipOwl is the largest scholarship marketplace in the U.S., connecting over 14 million Gen Z students with private scholarships — and the brands that power them. Our mission is to make education financing more accessible and engaging, while giving brands a way to connect with the next generation.

We’re powered by AI technology that simplifies scholarship discovery, streamlines the application process, and delivers measurable results for both students and partners. Whether it’s helping students secure funding or enabling brands to run impactful campaigns, we’re reshaping how education is funded — and discovered.

The Role

We’re looking for a Growth Product Manager to take full ownership of the conversion engine at ScholarshipOwl, from the first visitor touchpoint through to a paid subscription. This is a high-impact, high-velocity role for someone who lives in the data, thrives on experimentation, and values action over perfection.

You will be the architect of our growth. You’ll spend your days identifying leaks in the funnel, hypothesizing solutions, and working alongside a dedicated pod of engineers and designers to ship experiments that move the needle on revenue and retention. If you are a "full-stack" growth thinker who can move from a Mixpanel cohort analysis to a detailed technical spec this is the role for you.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the Conversion Engine: Take end-to-end responsibility for the user journey, optimizing every step from landing page registration to paywall conversion and subscription retention.

  • Drive the Experiment Roadmap: Build, prioritize, and maintain a high-tempo experimentation backlog. You will use frameworks (like ICE or RICE) to ensure we are always working on the highest-leverage growth bets.

  • Analyze & Diagnose: Monitor funnel and retention metrics daily in Mixpanel. You’ll identify exactly where users are dropping off and perform deep-dive discovery to understand the why.

  • Ship with Velocity: Write precise product specs and acceptance criteria that allow engineering and design to execute independently. We prioritize shipping "good enough" tests today to get data, rather than waiting for "perfect" features next month.

  • Optimize Revenue Levers: Design and run pricing, paywall, and offer optimization tests. You’ll also evaluate new growth levers like organic loops, landing page personalization, and winback programs.

  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Lead a dedicated pod of engineers and designers, maintaining strong working relationships with our dashboard and B2B teams to drive unified sprint priorities.

  • Continuous Discovery: Conduct meaningful customer discovery interviews with our Gen-Z audience to uncover behavioral insights that data alone can’t show.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of Product Management experience, specifically in a Growth-focused role.

  • Experimentation Mastery: Proven track record of designing, running, and analyzing A/B tests that resulted in measurable improvements to business KPIs (CVR, ARPU, Churn).

  • Data Fluency: You are a power user of product analytics tools (Mixpanel, Amplitude, or similar). You don't wait for a data analyst; you find the answers yourself.

  • SaaS/Subscription Expertise: You understand the nuances of subscription models—trial-to-paid transitions, renewal cycles, and friction-point reduction.

  • Technical Precision: Ability to write clear, "dev-ready" product specs and acceptance criteria. You understand technical trade-offs and how to scope an MVP.

  • Mentoring & Leadership: A mentoring and knowledge-sharing mindset with a desire to level up the broader team on growth methodologies and experimentation rigor.

  • Gen-Z Empathy: You have an intuition for (or experience with) B2C products targeting younger audiences and understand their unique digital behaviors.

  • Growth Mindset: You are comfortable with ambiguity, fast-moving environments, and the fact that 70% of experiments might fail—as long as we learn from them.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience with payment platforms (Stripe, Braintree) or Figma/prototyping tools.

  • Knowledge of lifecycle/email marketing, SEO, and paid acquisition channels.

  • Growth-focused certifications (e.g., Reforge).

  • Background in EdTech or student-facing products.

Why Join ScholarshipOwl?

  • Mission-Driven Work – Build technology that helps students unlock education opportunities.

  • Fully Remote – Work from anywhere while collaborating with a global team.

  • High Impact & Ownership – You aren't just a cog in a machine; you own the revenue engine.
